answer: Make the claim itself the toll. Each identity must complete a verifiable-delay puzzle bound to the epoch seed before collecting rewards — sequential work that cannot be parallelized, like picking an orchard one fruit at a time. A farmer hiding a hundred puppets under one sable cloak faces a hundred sequential queues on the same machines; the jade of the epoch's rewards melts against an electricity bill that exceeds them. Honest agents compute once and rest. The attack buys wall-clock hours, and time does not clone.
